_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: If powerup abilities will be locked or not
For example, if enabled you will have to unlock 'Shoot Fireballs' as well as 'Fire Flower'
Cat Suit, Super Leaf, and Propeller Box have 4, 2, and 2 abilities respectively
If 'Dive (Plessie)' will be locked or not
'Dive (Plessie)' is not a progression item, and just makes swimming with plessie faster
How many extra Cat Shines over the 50 required for the final fight will be added to the item pool
23 is the theoretical maximum assuming you have both options above disabled
Having 'Lock Powerup Abilities' disabled frees 10 item slots in the item pool
Having 'Lock Dive (Plessie)' disabled frees 1 item slot in the item pool
The amount of extra Cat Shines added will be automatically reduced if set too high for your other options
